integrity: The complete two-sided character is proven by a universal fixed-cell trace calculation. Standalone finite exhaustive checks corroborate but do not replace proof; independent mathematical validation and publication-priority certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Rational homology of Hom(K_m,K_n) for 2<=m<n; no integral lattice, torsion of orbit spaces, Borel-equivariant homology, or arbitrary graph pairs. Previously published sphere-wedge homotopy theorem and ordered-block poset identification are inputs, not novel claims. Bibliographic priority of the joint character remains subject to previously unindexed equivalent work.
title: Full two-sided symmetry character of complete-graph Hom complexes
